record.title: Compare isolated D capability selection and guest persistence
record.intent: Test a separately derived library that preserves MHO984 identity while selecting the MHO984D capability record.
requirements: Proceed only if the stock control establishes its expected identity, bandwidth and entitlement state; otherwise preserve the gate failure for the decision task.

Derive a new disposable library from the pinned specimen-identical source using the recovered32-byte replacement at offset0x42949c. Require exact original bytes, source hash, derived hash09689a442e8d285775b37089a8d631e1e445fe03d3499e830cdcc8f32439504e and a diff confined to that span. Never edit the source library or APK.
Use the same synthetic key/license/private seed and observation code as the stock arm. The capability selection is a binary experiment, not an ordinary entitlement or a physical1GHz claim.

Require actual GetModel to remain MHO984, selected record to become MHO984D, and stock raw/effective bandwidth getters to report enum18 before and after actual ParseOption. Preserve all14 option query states without installation or answer substitution.

Repeat in a fresh process and after reboot of the same disposable guest. Require changed boot identity, identical derived library and seed key/license/private hashes, no reinstall or regeneration, and repeated identity/enum18 outputs.
Stop and preserve any disagreement or new dependency. Keep full phase journals and hashes, host loopback isolation and guest health evidence. No physical contact or deployment.
acceptance: The identity-preserving capability comparison and persistence outcome are established
or the exact bounded failure is preserved.
